ex.en: My suitcase is overweight, so I have to pay an extra fee.
ex.zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以得付額外的費用。

ex.en: Overweight bags must be repacked before check-in.
ex.zh: 超重的行李必須在報到前重新整理。

ex.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
I know that Tom is a little overweight.
The flight was overbooked, so some passengers had to take a later one.
ex.zh: 這班飛機超賣了，所以有些乘客只好改搭晚一點的班機。

ex.en: Airlines sometimes offer vouchers when a flight is overbooked.
ex.zh: 航班超賣時，航空公司有時會提供抵用券。
